preconditions.description: A and B are integers representing the maximum total beers Mike and Joe can chug respectively.

postconditions.expression: return_value == "Non-drinkers can't play" if (A < 1 or B < 1) else ("Mike" if sum(k for k in range(1, 2 * n + 1, 2) for _ in [1] if sum(k for k in range(1, k + 1, 2)) <= A) >= sum(k for k in range(2, 2 * n + 2, 2) for _ in [1] if sum(k for k in range(2, k + 1, 2)) <= B) else "Joe")
postconditions.description: If either A or B is less than 1, return 'Non-drinkers can't play'. Otherwise, simulate the game where Mike drinks odd-numbered amounts (1, 3, 5, ...) and Joe drinks even-numbered amounts (2, 4, 6, ...), accumulating totals until one exceeds their limit; return the name of the player who does not exceed their limit first.
